Store daily actual costs for a stack

## Synopsis

```text
Prices actual cost for the stack and stores one point per resource, UTC day,
and currency. A day the plugin does not send is left untouched. The projected
timeline is not modified.

The default window is the last 30 complete UTC days. --from and --to accept
YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339, the same formats as cost actual.
```

```text
finfocus cost history collect-daily [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  finfocus cost history collect-daily --stack dev
  finfocus cost history collect-daily --stack dev --from 2026-10-01 --to 2026-10-08
  finfocus cost history collect-daily --stack dev --output json
```

## Options

```text
      --from string              Start date (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339); default is 30 complete UTC days ago
  -h, --help[=true|false]        help for collect-daily
      --output string            Output format: table or json (default table)
      --pulumi-json string       Path to Pulumi preview JSON output
      --pulumi-state string      Path to Pulumi state JSON from 'pulumi stack export'
      --terraform-state string   Path to a Terraform state file (mutually exclusive with --pulumi-json/--pulumi-state)
      --to string                End date (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339); default is the start of the current UTC day, or now when only --from is set
```
